question: What long-term wireless milestone did IIT Hyderabad and Japan’s SSIC achieve as of May 2025?

options.text: Test of Beyond 5G and 6G SDR SoC

solution:
The correct answer is __**Test of Beyond 5G and 6G SDR SoC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In **May 2025**, a landmark achievement in the field of wireless communication was recorded through a joint venture between **IIT Hyderabad (IITH)** and **Japan’s Space and Systems Innovative Center (SSIC)**.
 
• The milestone consists of the successful **Test of Beyond 5G and 6G SDR SoC**, which represents a critical leap toward the realization of the next generation of mobile connectivity.
 
• The collaboration utilized the specialized research facilities at **IIT Hyderabad**, which is a leading hub for **6G research** in **India**, in partnership with **Japanese** expertise in high-end semiconductor and satellite systems.
 
• The focus of the project was the development of a **Software Defined Radio (SDR)** based **System on Chip (SoC)**, which allows for the flexibility to handle multiple communication protocols through software updates rather than hardware changes.
